specs.title: Memory Tier (DRAM Cache Pool)

drifted.spec_text: evict_lru() cycles through shards via atomic counter (round-robin)
drifted.actual: No evict_counter or shards exist; evict_lru() calls ep.pop_oldest(state.pool_id) on the single global pool

drifted.spec_text: evict_lru_for_key() evicts from the same shard as the target key
drifted.actual: The key argument is ignored (bound as _key); function is a pure alias for evict_lru() with no shard-targeted behavior

drifted.spec_text: oldest_keys(n) peeks at N oldest keys across shards, sampling (n / NUM_SHARDS).max(1) per shard
drifted.actual: Single call to ep.peek_oldest(state.pool_id, n); no per-shard sampling logic exists
Cargo.toml package version is 0.1.0; define_component! macro version field is 0.3.0; neither matches 0.2.0

drifted.spec_text: Concurrent access from 16+ threads does not deadlock or corrupt state
drifted.actual: Correctness likely holds via single RwLock<Pool>, but the claimed 16-way shard-lock parallelism mechanism does not exist; all keys contend for one lock instead of one of 16

not_implemented: FR-007 (each shard has its own Mutex-protected allocator and slot map)
SC-8 (10 formal properties verified with Creusot, 21 verification conditions)

unspecced.feature: telemetry Cargo feature: MemoryTierTelemetry / TelemetrySnapshot / telemetry() / reset_telemetry() / telemetry_snapshot() (eviction count, write/read lock-contention counters)
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add a User Story / FR block documenting the optional telemetry feature: eviction count and read/write lock-contention counters exposed via telemetry_snapshot().
Add FR under Capacity Monitoring: free_capacity() returns capacity() minus used() for proactive eviction triggers.

unspecced.feature: DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE constant declared but never consumed by any call site (initialize() always requires an explicit pool_size argument)
unspecced.suggested_spec: Either wire DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE into a default constructor/initialize path, or document it in plan.md as reserved-for-future (as done for the NotEvictable error variant).
